Grimes (DAL) contests the driving shot attempt and incidental "high-five" contact occurs with Curry (GSW) after the release.

events.verdict: Curry (GSW) throws the pass to Wiggins (GSW), who is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.
Wiggins (GSW) legally contests Doncic's (DAL) jump shot, making "high-five" contact after the ball is released.
Doncic (DAL) and Green (GSW) briefly engage and disengage as they attempt to establish position.
Lively II (DAL) legally contests Curry's (GSW) jump shot attempt.
Curry (GSW) legally contests Grimes' (DAL) jump shot attempt and avoids making any illegal contact. The marginal contact that occurs is created by Grimes.
Thompson (DAL) commits a take foul on Wiggins (GSW).
Grimes (DAL) makes illegal contact to Curry's (GSW) arm, pulling it away from the ball.
Wiggins (GSW) legally contests Doncic's (DAL) jump shot, making "high-five" contact after the ball is released.
